engines.menus_note: The entries mods added to the game's menus. Choose one here to do what it does in the menu.

empty.none_hint: Add mods in the Kiln launcher (Library), put them in your profile, then start the game again.
empty.no_match_hint: Try another word, or clear the search box.
empty.nothing_hint: Pick All mods on the left.

details.pick_list: Pick a mod in the list to see what it is, whether it loaded, and its settings.
details.pick: Pick a mod to see its details.

menus.hidden: {mod}   ·   not in the game's menu now

about.native: DLL mods Kiln loads at start.
about.chain: Other DLLs Kiln starts next to the game.
about.emf: Enshrouded Mod Framework mods, run by Kiln.
about.eml: Enshrouded Mod Loader mods: they change the game's data before it starts.
about.xhl: XHL-Core plugins, placed in the game's mods folder. Only XHL-Core, installed separately, loads them; Kiln does not.
about.shroudforge: ShroudForge mods, run by the ShroudForge runtime.
about.set: Shrouded Engine Tweaks Lua mods, run by Kiln.
about.greeneye: Greeneye Loader mods, run by Kiln.
about.enshwick: Enshwick mods, run by Enshwick's loader.
about.dllmod: Enshrouded ModLoader mods (CarryOn, Belt Lantern), run by Kiln when a world of your own starts.

profile.no_mods: Play once without mods: no mod loads this start.
profile.invalid: The profile could not be read, so no mod loads.
profile.invalid_why: The profile could not be read, so no mod loads ({error}).
profile.legacy: No profile: Kiln loads the mods folders.
profile.name: Profile: {name}
profile.kept_xhl: Switched off in the profile, but its folder is still in the game's mods folder ({folder}), so XHL-Core may still load it.
profile.kept_enshwick: Switched off in the profile, but its folder is still in the game's mods folder ({folder}), so Enshwick's loader, which runs every folder there, may still run it.
profile.kept: Switched off in the profile, but its folder is still in the game's mods folder ({folder}), so a mod or loader that reads that folder may still use it.

help.turn_on: Turn it on in the Kiln launcher (Profiles), then start the game again.
help.kept: Remove it in the Kiln launcher, or move that folder out of the game's mods folder, to be sure it does not run.
help.repair: Repair or remove it in the Kiln launcher (Library), then start the game again.

file.invalid: it is cut off or not valid JSON
file.unreadable: the file could not be read: {error}
file.not_object: the file is not a JSON object

catalog.engine_unreadable: Kiln could not read this engine's report: {error}
catalog.report_unreadable: Its report could not be read: {error}

kiln.with_world: Starts with your own world, when you play alone or friends join you. It does not run in someone else's world.
kiln.hosted_off: Off in this game: its kiln.json turns off mods that start with your world (mods.hosted is false).
kiln.hosted_off_help: To let it start, remove "hosted": false from the "mods" part of kiln/kiln.json in the game folder, then start the game again.
kiln.pending: It loads when its turn comes (for example when a world starts).
kiln.disabled: Kiln switched it off after too many errors. Start the game again to retry, or update the mod.
kiln.failed: Read the reason above. Update the mod or what it needs in the Kiln launcher, then start the game again. kiln/logs/kiln.log has the details.
kiln.unloaded: It was unloaded by a command. Start the game again to load it.
kiln.not_reported: Listed in the profile, but Kiln did not load it this start.
kiln.not_reported_help: Start the game again. If it stays like this, check kiln/logs/kiln.log.

native.policy: Kiln's native policy does not load DLL mods on this game build.
native.failed_help: Read the reason above. Update the DLL mod in the Kiln launcher, then start the game again.
native.no_report: Kiln's native loader wrote no report this start.
native.old_report: The native loader's report is from an earlier start.
native.not_reported: Listed in the profile, but the native loader did not report it.

plugin.engine_failed: Kiln's {engine} plugin did not start: {error}. Its mods cannot run.
plugin.failed_help: Update or remove the plugin in the Kiln launcher, then start the game again.
plugin.no_report: Kiln's start report is missing, so it is not known whether it loaded.
plugin.not_reported: Listed in the profile, but Kiln did not load it.

chain.failed_help: Check the DLL in chain.ini (or the Kiln launcher), then start the game again.

ember.reason: Ember mods cannot run yet: Ember has not published a way for mods to run.
ember.help: Nothing to do now. The mod stays in your profile and runs once Kiln supports Ember mods.

dllmod.waiting: Starts when a world of your own starts.

shroudtopia.off_help: In shroudtopia/shroudtopia.json in the profile's config folder, set active to true in the mods entry named "{name}" (the name in kiln.log's Registered mod line). Save the file; Shroudtopia reads it again while the game runs.
shroudtopia.not_active: Switched on, but the mod does not report itself active.
shroudtopia.not_active_help: Kiln runs Shroudtopia mods through Shroudtopia 0.1.1's mod interface and keeps calling this mod's Activate. A mod made for another game version, or built against another Shroudtopia, can stay like this without doing anything. kiln/logs/kiln.log has its own lines as [shroudtopia:{name}]; the mod's author can tell whether it supports this game version.

engine_mods.own_loader: {engine}'s own loader runs the {engine} mods this start and reads only its own folder. Activate the profile again in the Kiln launcher (it copies the mod there), then start the game again.
engine_mods.failed_help: Read the reason above. Update the mod in the Kiln launcher, then start the game again. kiln/logs/kiln.log has the {engine} lines.
engine_mods.unreadable: {engine}'s report could not be read: {error}. Kiln reads it again in a moment.
engine_mods.not_run: {engine} did not run this start, so this mod did not load.
engine_mods.not_run_folder: {engine} did not run this start, so the mod did not load.
engine_mods.old_report: {engine} did not report this start (its last report is from an earlier start).
engine_mods.not_reported: Listed in the profile, but {engine} did not report it this start.
engine_mods.plugin_help: Check that Kiln's {engine} plugin is installed (kiln/plugins), then start the game again.
engine_mods.note_old: {engine} did not report this start; its last report is from an earlier start.

note.aside_emf: EMF: stepped aside for the real EMF.
note.aside_emf_why: EMF: stepped aside for the real EMF ({reason}).
note.aside: Stepped aside: another {engine} loader runs these mods.
note.aside_why: Stepped aside: another {engine} loader runs these mods ({reason}).
note.emf_idle: EMF went idle on this game build: {reason}

eml_patched.one: Game data patched before the game started ({count} change).
eml_patched.other: Game data patched before the game started ({count} changes).

note.eml_failed: EML failed: {error}. The game data was put back to normal.
note.eml_aside_sf: EML: stepped aside for ShroudForge, which runs the EML mods of its mods folder whose ShroudForge switch is on.
note.eml_aside: EML: stepped aside for EML's own loader.
note.eml_aside_why: EML: stepped aside for EML's own loader ({reason}).
note.ember: Ember: mods are found but cannot run yet.
note.dllmod_unsupported: Enshrouded ModLoader: its mods are made for game build 26430625, so none starts on this build.
note.dllmod_server: Enshrouded ModLoader: its mods are for the game client; a dedicated server starts none.
note.shroudlink_elsewhere: Another shroudlink loader runs these mods.
note.set_aside: SET: stepped aside for SET's own loader.
note.set_aside_why: SET: stepped aside for SET's own loader ({reason}).
note.set_waiting: Mods load at the main menu.

sf.hosted_menu: ShroudForge: runtime hosted by Kiln. Pick a mod to switch it and change its settings here (ShroudForge's own Modloader window is not running).
sf.hosted: ShroudForge: runtime hosted by Kiln. Pick a mod to switch it and change its settings.
sf.self_hosted: ShroudForge: its own loader runs the mods; Kiln stepped aside. Pick a mod to switch it and change its settings.
sf.not_installed: ShroudForge is not installed, so its mods cannot run.
sf.no_report: ShroudForge did not report this start.
sf.not_run: ShroudForge did not run this start.
sf.fix_first: Fix ShroudForge first (see the engine line), then start the game again.
sf.unconfirmed: ShroudForge runs, but Kiln could not read what it says about this mod (see the engine line). This is not proof the mod is active.
sf.eml_failed_help: Fix ShroudForge first (see kiln.log), then start the game again. Kiln EML stood aside and did not apply this mod.
sf.eml_aside_but: Kiln EML stood aside for ShroudForge, but {note}

eml_off.one: {count} of the profile's EML mods is switched off in ShroudForge, so nothing applies it this start. ShroudForge runs the EML mods of its folder whose ShroudForge switch is on.
eml_off.other: {count} of the profile's EML mods are switched off in ShroudForge, so nothing applies them this start. ShroudForge runs the EML mods of its folder whose ShroudForge switch is on.

sf.hand_off: You put this mod into ShroudForge's folder yourself, and ShroudForge has it switched off.
sf.hand_off_profile_help: Switch it on in Mods > ShroudForge (its own row there), or remove the folder and press Play in the Kiln launcher: the mod is in your profile, so Kiln then places its own copy, switched on.
sf.off_in_sf_help: ShroudForge runs it only once its switch is on: the reason above says where to switch it on. Then start the game again.
sf.no_switch_file: ShroudForge has not switched it on: it has no extended.mod.json, the file that holds ShroudForge's switch, so ShroudForge does not run it.
sf.package_unreadable: ShroudForge reads this folder, but Kiln cannot read the package as ShroudForge does ({error}); ShroudForge refuses a package it cannot read.
sf.eml_switch_off: In ShroudForge's mods folder, but its extended.mod.json (the file that holds ShroudForge's switch) says enabled: false, so nothing applies it this start.
sf.eml_no_switch: In ShroudForge's mods folder, but it has no extended.mod.json, the file that holds ShroudForge's switch, and ShroudForge keeps a package off until its switch is on, so nothing applies it this start.
sf.eml_press_play: Press Play in the Kiln launcher (or activate the profile again): Kiln switches it on in ShroudForge's settings. Then start the game again.
sf.eml_other_side: ShroudForge runs it on the {sides} only.
sf.eml_unconfirmed: Its ShroudForge switch is on, but ShroudForge's record of this start's startup pass does not list it at this version, so Kiln cannot confirm it was applied.
sf.startup_failed: ShroudForge's startup game-data pass failed in this game start.
sf.startup_failed_why: ShroudForge's startup game-data pass failed in this game start: {error}
sf.startup_failed_help: ShroudForge's log has the details. Start the game again once the cause is fixed.
sf.startup_applied: ShroudForge applied its game-data changes at the start of this game start (its record of the startup pass lists this mod). A change of its settings applies with the next start.
sf.startup_current: ShroudForge found its game-data changes of an earlier start still current for this start's mods (its record of the startup pass lists this mod). A change of its settings applies with the next start.
sf.settings_unreadable: Its package settings cannot be read; ShroudForge's per-mod activation is not confirmed.
sf.hand_off_help_live: Switch it on below, or remove the folder and add the mod with Add mods in the Kiln launcher. ShroudForge starts it while you play.
sf.hand_off_help_next: Switch it on below, or remove the folder and add the mod with Add mods in the Kiln launcher. It applies at the next game start.
sf.no_switch_help_live: Switch it on below: Kiln writes the extended.mod.json ShroudForge's own Modloader writes. ShroudForge starts it while you play.
sf.no_switch_help_next: Switch it on below: Kiln writes the extended.mod.json ShroudForge's own Modloader writes. It applies at the next game start.
sf.off_ext: Switched off in ShroudForge's settings (the mod's extended.mod.json).
sf.off_ext_repair: Switched off in ShroudForge's settings (the mod's extended.mod.json). {repair}
sf.repair_help: Change any of its settings, or switch it off and on, in Kiln's menu once: that repairs it.
sf.no_runtime: Its switch is on, but ShroudForge has no current per-mod runtime report. This is not proof the mod is active.
sf.error_help: Read the reason above. Update the mod, then start the game again. ShroudForge's log has the details.
sf.startup_unconfirmed: Enabled for startup game-data changes; ShroudForge's record of this start's startup pass does not list it at this version, so Kiln cannot confirm it.
sf.inactive: ShroudForge does not run it right now; a change of its switch takes a second or two, or it starts with the next game start.
sf.effect: ShroudForge Lua is active; reported effect: {effect}. {detail}
sf.effect_failed_help: The mod reports that its change did not apply. ShroudForge's log has the details.
sf.effect_last_failed: ShroudForge runs its Lua; the mod reports that its last change did not apply: {detail}
sf.effect_last_failed_help: The mod is still loaded and running. kiln.log says why the change did not apply: a "ShroudForge voxel write" line for a change of the world's blocks, the [sf] lines for anything else.
sf.active: ShroudForge runs its Lua; the mod reports no effect result.

enshwick.no_report: Enshwick did not report this start.
enshwick.not_run: Enshwick did not run this start.
enshwick.aside: Enshwick: stepped aside for Enshwick's own loader.
enshwick.runs_it: Enshwick's loader runs it. Enshwick reports no result per mod.
enshwick.fix_first: Fix Enshwick first (see the engine line), then start the game again.
enshwick.copy_failed: Kiln could not copy it into the game's mods folder.
enshwick.copy_failed_help: Close other tools that use the game's mods folder, then start the game again.
enshwick.removed: Removed from the game's mods folder.

xhl.prerequisite: Requires XHL-Core: only that separately installed host loads it. Import XHL-Core in the Kiln launcher as a Native mod and turn it on, or install it as its author says, then start the game again.
xhl.core_started: Placed in the game's mods folder for XHL-Core. XHL-Core started with the game, and it loads this plugin itself, not Kiln. Whether the plugin started is in XHL-Core's own log, XHL-Native-Plugin-Host.log next to XHL-Core.
xhl.placed: Placed in the game's mods folder for XHL-Core. Kiln does not load it, and Kiln cannot tell whether XHL-Core runs it.
xhl.found_core: An XHL-Core plugin in the game's mods folder. XHL-Core started with the game, and it loads this plugin itself, not Kiln. Whether the plugin started is in XHL-Core's own log, XHL-Native-Plugin-Host.log next to XHL-Core.
xhl.found: An XHL-Core plugin in the game's mods folder. Kiln does not load it, and Kiln cannot tell whether XHL-Core runs it.
xhl.note_core: XHL: placed for XHL-Core, a separate host. XHL-Core started with the game and loads these plugins; Kiln never loads them itself.
xhl.note: XHL: placed for XHL-Core, a separate host. Kiln never loads these plugin DLLs and does not check here whether XHL-Core is installed.

config.read_only_synced: Server config: read-only while connected to a server. Synced entries show the server's values.
config.read_only: Server config: read-only while connected to a server (it applies when you host).

server_values.one: {count} entry holds the server's value while connected (read-only).
server_values.other: {count} entries hold the server's value while connected (read-only).

config.server_value: The server's value. Yours: {value} (back when you leave).
config.read_only_nul: Read-only here: it holds a NUL character. Change it in the config file.
config.read_only_long: Read-only here: longer than 512 bytes. Change it in the config file.

describe.synced: Synced: a server sends its value to clients.
describe.restart: Requires a restart: a change applies when the mod loads again.
describe.from_server: Holds the server's value while connected.

applied.one: {count} change applied (saved when a world runs)
applied.other: {count} changes applied (saved when a world runs)

look.caption: LOOK
look.game_read: The game's look uses the game's own colours and font, read from your game.
look.game_not_read: The game's colours could not be read from your game (yet): a neutral dark stand-in is used.
look.saved: Saved in kiln/kiln.json ("ui"); the launcher's Settings show the same. Mods may offer more looks.

language.caption: LANGUAGE
language.missing: {language} (Kiln has no texts in this language)
language.saved: Kiln's own menus and messages; mods' texts follow the game's language. Saved in kiln/kiln.json ("ui"), as the launcher's Settings show.

set.about: SET Mod Settings, Compatibility, Entities, Hooks, Bindings, Console and local support report.
set.unavailable: SET tools are unavailable (kiln-set is not running).
set.open_failed: SET tools are unavailable; check the engine status.

waits.restart: The next game start: ShroudForge loads this mod's changed configuration only when the game starts again.
waits.dependency: A mod it needs: ShroudForge starts it once that mod runs (the reason above names it).
waits.write_access: Write access to the game world. ShroudForge gives it once a world this game hosts is running: your single-player world, or a co-op world you host. In someone else's world or on a dedicated server it may never come; there the mod has to run on the host's game or on the server.
waits.world: A world: it starts working once you are in a world this game hosts, not in the main menu.
waits.glide: You to glide. It changes the glider only while you are gliding, so between flights (and whenever this menu is open) it says waiting. That is normal: it applies when you take off.
waits.other: Something the mod needs is not there yet; its own words are under STATE above.

shroudforge.files_unreadable: its files could not be read: {error}
shroudforge.value_unreadable: the value of setting {setting} cannot be read ({error})
shroudforge.too_many: too many choices, groups or actions for this page (1000 combined at most). Change settings in the mod's extended.mod.json; the file is unchanged.
shroudforge.switch_live: ShroudForge switches it on or off while you play.
shroudforge.switch_next: Switching it on or off takes effect at the next game start (it changes game data when the game starts).
shroudforge.switch_profile: Your Kiln profile lists this mod: the Kiln launcher sets this switch from the profile when it starts the game. To keep a change, make it in the profile too.
shroudforge.repair: ShroudForge refuses this mod until its settings are saved once: an earlier Kiln wrote {settings} without its fraction.
shroudforge.repair_more: ShroudForge refuses this mod until its settings are saved once: an earlier Kiln wrote {settings} and {more} more without its fraction.
shroudforge.repair_here: {repair} Changing any setting or its switch here repairs it.

hidden.one: {count} more setting is not shown here (this mod has {total}; the page shows the first {shown}). Change them in the mod's extended.mod.json.
hidden.other: {count} more settings are not shown here (this mod has {total}; the page shows the first {shown}). Change them in the mod's extended.mod.json.

shroudforge.saved_to: Saved to the mod's extended.mod.json, the file ShroudForge and the Kiln launcher read.
shroudforge.next_start: Applies at the next game start.
shroudforge.shortcut_help: Click the box, then press the key or mouse button you want, with Ctrl, Shift or Alt if you like (Kiln saves the key's place on the keyboard, which ShroudForge reads on any layout). Click it again to stop waiting; Escape stops and closes the menu; Backspace, Delete or Unbind leave it without a key. You can also type it below: Ctrl+G, F5, Mouse4, or ShroudForge's own form such as Ctrl+SDL:10.
shroudforge.capture_wheel: {setting}: a ShroudForge shortcut cannot be a turn of the mouse wheel. Press a key or the middle or a side mouse button.
shroudforge.capture_pad: {setting}: a ShroudForge shortcut cannot be a controller button: ShroudForge's shortcuts read only the keyboard and the mouse. Press a key or a mouse button, or click the box again to stop.
shroudforge.capture_unknown: {setting}: Kiln does not know which key this is ({key}), so it cannot save it. Press another key, or type ShroudForge's form for it below (SDL: and the key's number).
shroudforge.field_nul: This value holds a NUL character, which a text field cannot show or keep: change it in the mod's extended.mod.json.
shroudforge.field_long: Too long to edit here ({length} characters): change it in the mod's extended.mod.json.

save.switch_live_on: Saved: {mod} is requested on; a running ShroudForge normally picks this up within a second or two. Check its state above.
save.switch_live_off: Saved: {mod} is requested off; a running ShroudForge normally picks this up within a second or two. Check its state above.
save.switch_next_on: Saved: {mod} is configured on for the next game start.
save.switch_next_off: Saved: {mod} is configured off for the next game start.
save.setting_live: Saved: {setting} can apply while its mod is active; ShroudForge normally picks this up within a second or two.
save.setting_next: Saved: {setting} is configured for the next game start.
save.unreadable_after: extended.mod.json was changed, but it cannot be read back: {error}. ShroudForge may refuse the mod until the file is fixed.

action.not_running: {action} was not sent: ShroudForge runs actions only while it runs the mod (see its state above). Nothing was queued.
action.still_waiting: {action}: an earlier request for {mod} (from this or an earlier game start) is still waiting for ShroudForge, which runs it once the mod takes it; nothing new was queued.

shroudforge.binding: ShroudForge mods: open Kiln's ShroudForge page

check.keep_one: {setting} must keep at least one choice so ShroudForge keeps its option type
check.null_first: {setting}: "{choice}" cannot come first in this list (it has no value, and ShroudForge would refuse the mod)
check.shortcut: {setting}: Kiln cannot read "{text}" as a key. Click the shortcut box and press the key you want, or type one such as Ctrl+G, F5 or Mouse4. ShroudForge's own form (Ctrl+SDL:10, Mouse:4) works too; empty switches the shortcut off.
check.length_min: {setting} must be {min} to any number of characters long

shroudlink.needs_addon: This requires a cooperating shroudlink client addon with bridge ABI v1. The stock addon is unchanged.
shroudlink.waiting: Waiting for a live shroudlink host, UI protocol 2, recognized world, and presentation lease.
shroudlink.no_entries: The host has not sent any menu entries.
shroudlink.declined: shroudlink declined the last request ({error}); refreshing its current state.

keys.help_mouse: Click a key, then press the new one: a key, the middle or a side mouse button, or a turn of the wheel, with Ctrl, Shift or Alt if you like (left and right click can't be bound). Click it again to cancel; Escape cancels and closes the menu. Unbind leaves an action without a key. Saved to kiln/config/keybinds.json.
keys.help_pad: A controller works too: click a key binding, then press a pad button, or hold LB, RB, LT or RT and press another for a combination (Pad:LB+A); press and release LB, RB, LT or RT alone to bind that button.
keys.help: Click a key, then press the new one. Click it again to cancel; Escape cancels and closes the menu. Unbind leaves an action without a key. Saved to kiln/config/keybinds.json.

toast.wheel_menu: The Kiln menu's key can't be on the wheel ({key}): it would close the menu as you scroll it
toast.pad_menu: The Kiln menu's key can't be a controller button ({key}): the menu is opened from the keyboard or a mouse button

network.on: Kiln's network is on: mods can talk between this game and a Kiln server.
network.off: Kiln's network is not running in this session.
network.stats: Role: {role}. Messages in {in}, out {out}, dropped {dropped}. Channels: {channels}. Largest message: {largest} bytes.

sync.applied: content: {count} change(s) from the server{reset}{errors} ({kib:F0} KiB)
sync.hosting: content: hosting (the server's content is this game's)
sync.none: content: the server sent no content state
sync.configs: configs: {count} synced config(s) from the server, {used} in use here
sync.configs_none: configs: the server sent no synced configs

repl.caption: Replication
repl.count: Count what this game sends each peer
repl.off: Off. Counting costs a little on the game's network jobs. In a hosted world your own client is the local peer; a client that joined a server sends nothing here (the server shows its own with the repl commands).

overlay.frames: presents {presents}, drawn {drawn}, last overlay frame {ms:F2} ms
overlay.screen_station: game screen: {kind} ({state}/{hud}), language {language}, UI frame {frame}; crafting station workshop 0x{workshop:x8} recipe 0x{recipe:x8}
overlay.screen_own: game screen: {kind} ({state}/{hud}), language {language}, UI frame {frame}; crafting own workshop 0x{workshop:x8} recipe 0x{recipe:x8}
overlay.panels_on: screens open {screens}, crafting panels {panels}, menu extension on
overlay.panels_off: screens open {screens}, crafting panels {panels}, menu extension off

mods.no_pages: Mods add config pages with Ui.AddConfigPage (the config registry's editor plugs in here).

gamemenu.scroll_crashed: Kiln: the scrolling pause menu ended the game last time, so it stays off; Kiln's Mods page lists the mods' menu entries.

summary.auto_scrolls: The pause menu shows every one of them and scrolls when they do not fit (Kiln settings, modEntries: Auto).
summary.auto: A game menu shows them while it has at most 3, so its own entries (Quit) stay on the screen (Kiln settings, modEntries: Auto; this menu does not scroll here).
summary.always: The game's menus show every one of them (Kiln settings, modEntries: Always).
summary.never: The game's menus show none of them (Kiln settings, modEntries: Never).
summary.few: A game menu shows them while it has at most 3, so its own entries (Quit) stay on the screen (Kiln settings, modEntries: Few).

not_drawn.one: {how} {count} of them is not in the game's menu now; choose it here.
not_drawn.other: {how} {count} of them are not in the game's menu now; choose them here.

toast.render_off_errors: {mod}: a render handler was turned off (errors)
toast.render_off_slow: {mod}: a render handler was turned off (too slow)

refusal.needs_one: It needs a mod you don't have:
refusal.needs_many: It needs mods you don't have:
refusal.modpack: The Kiln launcher offers this server's modpack.
refusal.add: Add them in the Kiln launcher, then join again.

creative.title: Creative

creative.no_server: This server has no Kiln creative menu (it needs Kiln on the server).

log.title: Kiln: Game Log
log.hidden: ({count} older line(s) not drawn; filter to find them)

cap.caption: Frame cap
cap.hint: The game renders at most this many frames a second: Kiln spaces out the starts of its frames evenly. Applies at once. With the game's own frame limit or V-Sync on too, the lowest limit decides.

dlss.caption: DLSS (NVIDIA RTX cards)
dlss.preset_hint: Default leaves it to the game and DLSS. J and K are DLSS 4's transformer models, L and M the newer ones of DLSS 4.5. DLAA keeps the game's preset. The NVIDIA app's DLSS override, when you set one there, wins over this.
dlss.scale_hint: The share of the game's resolution DLSS renders at before it upscales: lower is faster, higher is sharper. DLAA always renders at full size. DLSS settings apply when the game next sets DLSS up: when a world loads, or when you change the DLSS mode or the resolution in the game's settings.

scale.per_mode: A scale for each DLSS mode

readout.caption: Readout
readout.hint: A few lines in the top right corner: frames a second (rendered and output), frame time, the upscaler with its mode, render and output size, and the DLSS preset. Latency is not shown: Kiln cannot measure it honestly in this game.

status.caption: Now
status.unavailable: Kiln's graphics tools need the kiln-ui.dll of Kiln 0.2.0-dev.29.18 or later.
status.cap_aside: Frame cap ({fps} fps): off, left to {tools}.
status.fps: Rendered {rendered} fps, output {output} fps, {ms} ms a frame.
status.dlss_limited: Your render scale is outside what DLSS allows in {mode}: it renders at the nearest size DLSS allows (above).
status.dlss_idle: DLSS is not in use right now (the game uses FSR 3, XeSS or no upscaler, or no world is loaded).
status.dlss_none: The game has not set DLSS up in this session (DLSS needs an NVIDIA RTX card and DLSS chosen in the game's settings).
status.restart: Restart the game for Kiln's DLSS settings and the readout's DLSS line: Kiln hooks DLSS only when one of them is on when the game starts.

aside.nvngx: another DLSS loader (nvngx.dll next to the game)
aside.upscaler: another upscaler tool (AMD's or Intel's upscaler files next to the game, or a changed FSR 3 pass)

upscaler.caption: Behind the game's FSR 3
upscaler.amd_hint: Auto runs FSR 3.1 until FSR 4 is confirmed in this game. FSR 4 (experimental) lets AMD choose: FSR 4 on graphics cards and drivers that run it, FSR 3.1 on the others; it may render dark scenes too dark.
upscaler.hint: Choose FSR 3 as the upscaler in the game's graphics settings: Kiln runs your choice in its place. A change applies at once while FSR 3 runs in a world, else when a world loads. Kiln needs the vendor's files for AMD FSR and Intel XeSS; the Kiln launcher downloads them (Settings, Graphics).

files.missing: {name}'s files are not in this game yet. Download them in the Kiln launcher (Settings, Graphics) while the game is closed. Until then the game's own FSR 3 runs.
files.changed: Some of {name}'s files in {folder} are missing or changed. Download them again in the Kiln launcher (Settings, Graphics) while the game is closed. Until then the game's own FSR 3 runs.

running.off: Kiln's upscaler is not in use behind the game's FSR 3 now.
running.not_fsr: The game is not upscaling with FSR 3 right now: FSR 3 is not chosen in the game's graphics settings, or no world is loaded.
running.amd_fsr4: AMD FSR 4 runs in place of the game's FSR 3.
running.amd_fsr31: AMD FSR 3.1 runs in place of the game's FSR 3.
running.xess: Intel XeSS runs in place of the game's FSR 3.
running.unknown: Kiln cannot tell what upscales behind the game's FSR 3: its parts are of different versions.

upscaler.amd_fsr3_auto: AMD's selection chose FSR 3.1: FSR 4 does not run on this graphics card or driver.
upscaler.restart_now: Restart the game to use {upscaler}. Until then the game's own FSR 3 runs.

reason.restart: {upscaler} runs from the next start of the game: Kiln sets it up when the game starts.
reason.files_missing: {upscaler}'s files are not downloaded yet, so the game's own FSR 3 runs.
reason.files_bad: A file of {upscaler} is not the one Kiln expects (its size or SHA-256 differs), so Kiln does not load it. Download it again.
reason.load_failed: A file of {upscaler} did not load, so the game's own FSR 3 runs.
reason.device: Your graphics card or driver lacks a Vulkan feature {upscaler} needs, so the game's own FSR 3 runs.
reason.create_failed: {upscaler} could not be set up for this resolution, so the game's own FSR 3 runs.
reason.runtime_failed: {upscaler} failed while it upscaled. The game's own FSR 3 runs until you restart the game.
reason.fault: {upscaler} or Kiln's code around it faulted. The game's own FSR 3 runs until you restart the game.
reason.aside: Kiln steps aside for {tools}, so it does not change the game's FSR 3.
reason.no_signatures: Kiln does not know this game build's FSR 3 yet, so the game's own FSR 3 runs. A Kiln update for this game build fixes that.
reason.inputs: The game's images are not what {upscaler} takes, so the game's own FSR 3 runs.
reason.unavailable: {upscaler} is not available in this build of Kiln or on this system, so the game's own FSR 3 runs.
reason.waiting: {upscaler} is ready. It starts as soon as the game runs FSR 3: load a world with FSR 3 chosen in the game's graphics settings.
reason.no_vulkan: Kiln did not see the game set up its graphics device in this session. Restart the game for {upscaler}.
reason.unknown: {upscaler} does not run (reason {number} from a newer Kiln), so the game's own FSR 3 runs.

graphics.saved: Saved in kiln/kiln.json (the launcher's Settings page has them too).
